title: The Linden Street Gazette

headings.text: A new library corner for Year 3

key_sentences: I would like to thank every family for their patience while the new classrooms were being finished.
The inspectors praised the reading programme and the kindness of our older pupils towards the youngest children.
The pupils chose many of the titles themselves after a vote in each class.
Pupils can take two books home each week, and the class keeps a wall chart of the books everyone has finished.
Sports day will take place on Friday 12 June instead of in May, because the playing field is being reseeded.
Please sign up at the office or on the sheet by the main gate.
The menu was planned with a dietitian and tested by the school council in March.
Their support makes activities possible that the school could not otherwise afford.

list_items.text: 27 March – Last day of term, school closes at 13:30
14 April – Pupils return after the Easter holidays
